title: feat(driver-sql): the share-grant subquery converts a RAW(16) uuid key on Oracle as the list binds it (ADR-0155 O2)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvMi1U7R2kBd3JbTPu

Fixes #35952

## 维护者速读
- 问题：Oracle 上主键用 RAW(16) 存 uuid 的表，共享子查询（ADR-0155 第 3 步）今天是**静默漏行**，不是卡片原以为的 ORA-01465 报错。实测（Oracle Free 23ai）：子查询答 `[]`，计数 0，取反时反而答出全部行。
- 这一步做什么：按你在 #35906 裁的 A（按主键类型比较、结果同今天）补到 Oracle：子查询里先用和名单同一条 uuid 规则校验授权 id，合格的转成和名单一样的二进制形式，不合格的让整条语句报错。实测：名单接受的每种写法都同行；名单拒绝的每种写法，子查询都整句报错（名单 400，子查询 500 ORA-01465）。
- 合同审查认定这个差别（同为拒绝，只是状态码不同）不改变 D-0，不需要你决定。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-oracle-dialect.ts`: `oracleUuidRawProjection`, beside `oracleUuidRawBinding`: `HEXTORAW(CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(record_id, UUID_TEXT, 'i') THEN REPLACE(record_id, '-', '') ELSE 'not-a-uuid' END)`. The Oracle pattern (`ORACLE_UUID_TEXT_PATTERN`) is derived in one place from the list's own `UUID_TEXT`, with a load-time guard so the two cannot drift. A grant the list admits converts exactly as the list binds it; a grant the list refuses fails the statement.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts`: the leaf's `$in` arm reads the existing RAW(16) prime (`oracleRawUuidFieldsByObject`, primed at every Oracle door) and passes `oracleRawUuid` down. Nothing about the prime is restated.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-internal-helpers.ts`: `fixedReadLeafSubquery` projects the conversion on Oracle for a RAW(16) uuid key only. The outer argument is now a named type, `FixedReadLeafOuter`. #35906's PostgreSQL arm is untouched, and Oracle never reaches its no-reading refusal (pinned).
- `sql-driver.ts` (stub signature, 10067 lines, unchanged count), one ADR anchor file, changeset `.changeset/35952-oracle-raw-share-grant-key.md` (driver-sql patch).

## Why
Ruling A on #35906 (7051669729): compare by the key's type, same rows as today's list (ADR-0155 D-0). Seat 7 carried it to every dialect `driver-sql` ships. Part of the ADR-0155 chain; it unblocks step 6 (#33787).

## Measured on live Oracle Free 23ai (testkit `ORACLE_CELL`)
Fixture: a RAW(16)-keyed table, grants upper-case dashed, lower-case dashed and undashed, plus a blank grant.

| Case | List (today) | Leaf before | Leaf after |
|---|---|---|---|
| Upper-case + lower-case grants | `[U2, U1]` | `[]` | `[U2, U1]` |
| Undashed grant | `[U1]` | `[]` | `[U1]` |
| Negation | `[U3]` | every row | `[U3]` |
| Count | 2 | 0 | 2 |
| Nested under ReadableIds | `[c1, c2]` | `[]` | `[c1, c2]` |
| `NUMBER(10)` key (`'42'`, `'07'`, `' 7'`) | `[42, 7]` | `[42, 7]` | `[42, 7]` (unchanged SQL) |

### A stored grant the list would refuse
The list judges each comparand before any SQL; the leaf now applies the same `UUID_TEXT` check inside the statement. Measured on live Oracle Free 23ai, each malformed grant stored beside a valid one, find and negation:

| Stored grant `record_id` | List | Leaf before the gate | Leaf now |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 hex digits | 400 | silent; one 31-digit form GAINED a row | 500 ORA-01465 |
| 33 hex digits, `0123`, `abc` | 400 | grant silently dropped | 500 ORA-01465 |
| 32 hex digits, misplaced dashes | 400 | MATCHED a row | 500 ORA-01465 |
| `-`, all dashes | 400 | negation silently empty | 500 ORA-01465 |
| blank, padded, not hex, braced, `urn:uuid:` | 400 | 500 ORA-01465 | 500 ORA-01465 |
| Every admitted form (dashed or undashed, any case) | rows | rows | the list's rows |

The contract review (7058145514) ruled the loud class (list 400, leaf 500) no change to D-0: ADR-0155's Consequences and ruling A both say a malformed grant fails the statement. The gate closes the classes it ruled a change (M1), so nothing goes to the maintainer.

## Verification
- Head `869573acbdc023bd64e70dbaa3db7a0761683711`: `ca269e1fa4` (the conversion) plus `869573acbd` (the M1 gate), on main after #35906 merged as 850bcec018.
- At `869573acbd`: conformance + key-type files live on Oracle + SQLite, 90 passed / 2 skipped, 27 live Oracle pins green. Full driver-sql suite with Oracle, PG 16.15 and SQLite live: 5945 passed / 132 skipped, exit 0. Typecheck and eslint exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` 80 of 80 exit 0. Ablation of the gate (the bare `HEXTORAW(REPLACE(…))`): exactly the 9 predicted pins go red; restored blob-equal.
- Earlier, at `ca269e1fa4`, live Oracle Free 23ai (`ORACLE_CELL`): the conformance file at that head, 64 passed / 2 skipped (PG and MySQL not provisioned), with its 14 live Oracle pins green; the full driver-sql suite at that head (SQLite, Oracle env set) 4652 passed, exit 0. On #35906's head with PG 16.15 also live: full driver-sql 5926 passed / 132 skipped.
- ⚠️ No CI lane provisions Oracle, so the 27 live Oracle pins never run in CI, before or after merge. They were run here, against a local Oracle Free 23ai container. CI's `Temporal Conformance` lane runs the live PG and MySQL cells only.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck` exit 0; eslint on the changed files exit 0; driver-turso leaf conformance 54/54 (on #35906's head).
- `dispatch-gates --ran` at `ca269e1fa4` after a full packages build: 80 derived, 80 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0. `check-changeset-no-major` exit 0 (patch, `Clause-②: yes`, `Metadata-protocol: none`).
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob-equal): the Oracle projection switched off → 10 failed live (the RAW find/count, negation/`$or`, predicate update, statement, nested, aggregate, the three refused-grant pins and the RAW compile pin); NUMBER, never-primed and other-dialect pins stay green.

Clause-②: yes
The compiled share-grant subquery changes its SQL on Oracle for a RAW(16) uuid key, keeping D-0's same rows (ruled A).
Metadata-protocol: none

## Acceptance notes
- Filed #35960 (out of scope, pre-existing on main): the Oracle RAW(16) prime never walks a composed ReadableIds scope's parent, so a `controlled_by_parent` child read of a RAW-keyed parent misses silently, even in today's list form, until something has read the parent. This PR's nested pin primes the parent explicitly and says so.
- `.changeset/35906-pg-share-grant-key-type.md` says Oracle RAW(16) keys are not measured. That was true for #35906; this PR's changeset states the Oracle change. If both ship in one release, the CHANGELOG carries both sentences.
- MySQL and SQL Server cells were not run here (no cell).
- L1 (7058114575) asked that step 6 (#33787) carry a precondition that the producer writes only canonical uuid text into `record_id` for a RAW(16)-keyed object. Recorded on #33787; with the gate, a non-canonical grant now fails loudly instead. L1's N1 is done in `869573acbd`.
